commits.message: feat: bucket reports by the reporter's calendar day

files.tests/test_report.py:
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone

from src.report import report_day

BERLIN = timezone(timedelta(hours=2))


def test_a_utc_evening_belongs_to_the_next_local_day():
    moment = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 23, 30, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    assert report_day(moment, BERLIN) == date(2026, 1, 2)


def test_a_utc_morning_stays_on_the_same_local_day():
    moment = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 9, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    assert report_day(moment, BERLIN) == date(2026, 1, 1)
